notes.claim: Physics teaching uses a predict, observe, explain cycle: students commit to a prediction, see the outcome, then resolve any conflict between the two.

sources.title: Role of physics lecture demonstrations in conceptual learning | Phys. Rev. ST Phys. Educ. Res.
sources.quote: In the context of demonstrations, the “elicit, confront, resolve” cycle is better known as “predict, observe, explain” (POE)
